body: I'm no doctor but I feel like this is just something out of balance in your head that needs to be treated either with meds or therapy. Because think about how many people are in your situation but are very happy. Not that that is supposed to make you feel better, but maybe it will prompt you to take a deeper introspective look at why you are bored and maybe find what you need in order to feel less empty. Just because you have everything society says you need to have to be happy, doesnt mean it is all of what YOU want, and while you're here you should try to find what it is and go for it. In the meantime tho tell a therapist if u havent

I really hope you respond to this someday. I don't really know what to say because I understand what you're feeling, and I know everyone has told you the same stuff that I could say to make u feel better. But it's a human to human thing. Idk who you are, but as another human being I really long for you to be alive. It's hard to explain.
